dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-pixel mottling visible across the anterior and mid-dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between subtle pigmented variations and the primary grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast linear white markings visible on the posterior right dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible longitudinal dorsal ridge along the posterior central axis creating a distinct shadow-cast.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine linear white scratches or rake marks located on the posterior right dorsal quadrant.
